name: Movement USDCx
oneLiner: USDCx is Movement's native USDC-backed dollar issued 1:1 via Circle's xReserve smart contract, with CCTP/Gateway transfers to and from USDC on other chains.

sources.label: Circle exact Movement USDCx launch and 1:1 backing

dependencyReview.rationale: Circle identifies the exact Movement token as fully backed 1:1 by USDC held in xReserve. Deposit and withdrawal attestations conserve a fixed USDC claim rather than a yield-bearing NAV or local loss-absorption position. USDC is the serial parent; Movement minting, cross-chain attesters, contract control and redemption fees remain local risks, not inherited protective controls.

relationships.reason: Issuer-documented fixed 1:1 USDC representation; xReserve/Movement bridge and deployment controls remain local.

collateral: 1:1 USDC held in a Circle-deployed xReserve smart contract; the underlying reserve is Circle USDC, whose backing is short-duration U.S. Treasuries and cash held by regulated custodians.
pegMechanism: Users mint USDCx on Movement by depositing USDC into Circle's xReserve smart contract, which issues USDCx 1:1; redemption burns USDCx and releases the underlying USDC back to the user. xReserve also enables 1:1 transfers between USDCx and USDC across supported chains via Circle CCTP and Gateway without third-party bridges.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 implementation-date review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Movement's launch announcement and Circle's xReserve documentation describe USDCx as a 1:1 USDC-backed representation minted when USDC is deposited into the xReserve contract and burned on redemption, establishing the fiat-cash mechanism used by the current deployment.

slice.name: USDC held as Circle xReserve native collateral for the Movement domain
